text: In 1971 Roger and Carolyn Perron [move their five daughters into a Rhode Island farmhouse|trigger|making a new home], where the dog will not go inside and every clock stops at 3:07 in the morning. Carolyn wakes with new bruises, the family uncovers a boarded-up cellar, and the demonologists Ed and Lorraine Warren learn the land bears [the curse of a witch who sacrificed her baby|origin|curses laid by others]. As the spirit [takes hold of Carolyn|threat|being taken over], the Warrens [put themselves and their own daughter in its path|who_suffers|those who step in] to attempt an exorcism without the Church's approval.
